Our on-call rota has one rule now: whoever gets paged writes the runbook entry before they go back to sleep.

Forty entries in three months. Every one of them is angry, specific and correct.

The polished runbook we wrote in a workshop had nine entries. None of them mentioned the thing that actually pages you, which is the certificate.
